env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
# Caller-owned defaulted struct through a defining-package generic
# (SPEC T-205): the instance is compiled for the defining package, but
# the default factory lives in the instantiating package. The program
# builds and runs, and the literal carries the default.
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^localhost$'
stdout '^b-private$'
stdout '^inferred-b-private$'
stdout '^third$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/cown

go 1.27

-- w/b/b.lgo --
package b

import "comptime"

func F[T any]() T {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return T{}
	} else {
		var out T
		return out
	}
}

type private struct {
	Tag string = "b-private"
}

func UsePrivate() string {
	return F[private]().Tag
}

func G[T any](v T) T {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return T{}
	} else {
		return v
	}
}

func Make() private {
	return private{}
}

func UseInferred() string {
	return "inferred-" + G(Make()).Tag
}

-- w/a/a.lgo --
package a

type Third struct {
	Name string = "third"
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/cown/a"
	"example.com/cown/b"
	"fmt"
)

type S struct {
	Host string = "localhost"
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(b.F[S]().Host)
	fmt.Println(b.UsePrivate())
	fmt.Println(b.UseInferred())
	fmt.Println(b.F[a.Third]().Name)
}
